title: Dashboard in an AI assistant
caption: Claude uses the dashboard actions as MCP tools. EXT:dashboard contains no MCP-specific code.
alt: Claude shows the TYPO3 dashboard of the user through MCP tools

title: Actions as MCP tools
caption: Claude groups the tools as read-only, because of the hints that TYPO3 derives from the action type.
alt: MCP tools of a TYPO3 instance in Claude

title: OAuth consent
caption: The consent screen shows which app asks for which scopes, and the user decides. After the login, the route option `redirect.standalone` leads back to the consent screen.
alt: OAuth consent screen of an MCP client

title: API Hub
caption: The API Hub module lists all apps with access to the installation.

title: App configuration
caption: Administrators configure type, scopes, logo and redirect URI in System › Integrations › API Hub.
alt: App record with type, identifier, secret, scopes and redirect URI

title: Swagger UI
caption: Swagger UI lists every action from the generated document, with “try it out”.
alt: Swagger UI with the routes of all actions

title: Schema from TCA
caption: The schema has a variant for each content type of `tt_content`.
alt: JSON Schema of tt_content derived from TcaSchema
